title: Finite coefficient change of the normalized inverse smooth orientation
statement: Let $D$ be the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with algebraic closure $k$ of characteristic $p$, and let $\ell\ne p$ be prime. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated smooth $k$-morphism of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$, with a compactification. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map $\varphi$ of finite commutative rings, both killed by $\ell^n$, where $n\ge1$. In the ordinary etale derived module categories of the universe-lifted rings, put $\omega_R=f_R^!R_Y$ and $L_R=R_X(d)[2d]$, with the ordered shifted-root-line model of [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps]. Fix a deformation geometry for the smooth diagonal and isomorphisms $\alpha_R:\omega_R\xrightarrow{\sim}L_R$ satisfying exactly its diagonal, t=1-normalized Rees, and integration-normalized bundle equation OrientationNormalized. Let $e$ be a CoefficientLineComparison [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows] for $\varphi$ at the common exponent, including the root-power, scalar/root-generator, and derived-scalar-counit normalizations. Write $S_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ and $\delta:S_X\omega_A\to\omega_B$ for the counit-defined exceptional coefficient mate at $A_Y$, followed by the scalar-unit multiplication map [lem-pur-exceptional-coefficient-comparison]. Then $S_X(\alpha_A^{-1})\,;\,\delta=e^{\otimes d}\,;\,\alpha_B^{-1}$. This is an equation at the coefficient unit; it does not assert compatibility of the tensor map on arbitrary inputs.

proof.text: Derive IsNoetherian X and IsNoetherian Y from local finite type and quasi-compactness over the finite-field datum. Derive QuasiCompact f from compactness of X and quasi-separatedness of Y. These are the same instances explicitly used in the supplied normalization hypotheses.

Apply normalizedOrientation_scalar to the universe-lifted ring homomorphism, with N=M=ell^n and reflexive divisibility. Positivity follows from primality of ell. The prime setting supplies invertibility of this exponent on X and Y. Pass the supplied geometry, orientations, normalization equations and CoefficientLineComparison unchanged. This proves exactly the inverse-orientation equation at the coefficient unit.

theorem reductionOrientation
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : ℓ ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f]
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [HasCompactification f]
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hA : ((ℓ ^ n : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1, u} A) = 0)
    (hB : ((ℓ ^ n : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1, u} B) = 0)
    (geometry : Etale.FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d
      (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.diagonal f))
    (alphaA : Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) f ≅
      Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.line (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) (ℓ ^ n) hA X d)
    (alphaB : Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) f ≅
      Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.line (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) (ℓ ^ n) hB X d)
    (_ha : @Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.OrientationNormalized (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) _ _
      (ℓ ^ n) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos n) hA X Y
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian
          (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))
        toCompactSpace := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace
          (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)) } f _
      (@quasiCompact_of_compactSpace X Y f
        (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)))
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k)))) _ d geometry
      ((finiteGeneralRingPrimeSetting D ℓ hℓ n hn).diagonalExponent_isUnit
        (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))) alphaA)
    (_hb : @Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.OrientationNormalized (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) _ _
      (ℓ ^ n) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos n) hB X Y
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian
          (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))
        toCompactSpace := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace
          (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)) } f _
      (@quasiCompact_of_compactSpace X Y f
        (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)))
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k)))) _ d geometry
      ((finiteGeneralRingPrimeSetting D ℓ hℓ n hn).diagonalExponent_isUnit
        (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))) alphaB)
    (e : Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.CoefficientLineComparison
      (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) (ℓ ^ n) (ℓ ^ n) hA hB X)
 :
    (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.ordinaryScalar
      (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) X).map alphaA.inv ≫
        Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.dualizingScalarMap
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) f =
      (e.tensorPower d).hom ≫ alphaB.inv
